EasyTier-EUI.desc: 简化使用EasyTier的一种UI界面，快速组网
EasyTier-EUI.author: BoB
EasyTier-EUI.changelog:
- 优化：安卓首个配置，默认开启启动重连功能
- 优化：安卓快捷设置磁贴启动VPN，默认不打开WebView界面，静默后台运行，仅显示系统通知，减少运存使用（参考值：90-60MB）
- 修复：安卓快捷设置磁贴启动VPN，默认当前设备显示localhost，而不是设备名称
----
- 优化：减少滚动日志大小，安卓版本默认关闭日志
- 优化：安卓版本快捷设置磁贴状态显示，更精准
- 优化：安装内核显示进度
- 优化：保存配置时，如果是运行中配置，且保存的配置没启动成功，则回滚到上一个配置
- 修复：修复启动应用时 stun 没自动恢复启动（仅 FnOS / FygoOS / Docker 版本支持开机运行）
----
- 优化：【配置】页面，新增 DeepWiKi AI 问答入口 
- 优化：减少STUN日志生成量
- 修复：清理日志后，stun 报错找不到日志目录
----
- 修复：部分场景下，自更新失败
- 修复：重命名后，自启被关闭
- 新增：Windows、MacOS 版本支持系统托盘开关，可选在【设置】页面关闭([Issues #11](https://github.com/710850609/EasyTier-EUI/issues/11))
- 新增：安卓版本支持多配置同时运行（需要 EasyTier 2.7.1及其以上版本）
---
- 优化：Linux版本stun keep live期间断网处理（飞牛系统自更新的，需要重启stun才生效）
- 优化：飞牛版本兼容云电脑环境状态识别

----
- Optimization: Enable auto-reconnect by default for the first configuration on Android
- Optimization: Android Quick Settings tile now starts VPN silently in the background without opening the WebView, showing only system notification, reducing memory usage (reference: 90→60MB)
- Fix: Android Quick Settings tile VPN start now displays actual device name instead of localhost
----
- Optimization: Reduced rolling log size, logging is disabled by default on Android
- Optimization: More accurate status display for the Android Quick Settings tile
- Optimization: Show installation progress for the core
- Optimization: When saving a config, if the running config fails to start after saving, it now rolls back to the previous config
- Fix: Fixed STUN not auto-restarting when the app starts (only FnOS / FygoOS / Docker versions support running at boot)
----
- Improvement: Added DeepWiki AI Q&A entry on the [Config] page
- Improvement: Reduced STUN log generation volume
- Fix: STUN reported log directory not found error after clearing logs
----
- Fix: Self-update failed in some scenarios
- Fix: Auto-start was disabled after renaming
- New: Windows and macOS versions now support system tray toggle, with an option to disable it on the [Settings] page ([Issues #11](https://github.com/710850609/EasyTier-EUI/issues/11))
- New: Android version now supports running multiple configs simultaneously (requires EasyTier 2.7.1 or above)
----
- Optimization: On Linux, handle network disconnection during STUN keep-alive (for FeiNiu system self-updates; requires restarting STUN to take effect)
- Optimization: FeiNiu version now supports state detection in cloud computer (desktop) environments, accommodating suspend/wake behavior
